Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning business payment contracts containing a personal guarantee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to procedures for written business contracts; andadding a new chapter to Title 19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Authorized business representative" means a natural personauthorized to conduct business on behalf of a business entity,including a limited liability company, corporation, or nonprofitcorporation, registered in Washington or another state. (2) "Business payment contract containing a personal guarantee"means a written agreement between two or more parties in which at leastone party is an authorized business representative who, asconsideration for the agreement, promises to guarantee the debt of abusiness entity.

Any business payment contract containing apersonal guarantee must contain the following for each authorizedbusiness representative who is a party to the agreement and who ismaking a personal guarantee: p. 1 SHB 1535 (1) A separate signature line, directly following and on the samepage as any other signature line or lines that the authorized businessrepresentative must sign to signal his or her acceptance of theagreement; (2) The signature line must be preceded directly on the same pageby the phrase, "DISCLOSURE: By signing this contract you, theundersigned, are agreeing to PERSONALLY GUARANTEE payment according tothe terms of this contract." The phrase must be written in bold,fourteenpoint or larger font in clearly visible ink.

The personal guarantee of an authorizedbusiness representative in a business payment contract containing apersonal guarantee found not to meet the requirements of section 2 ofthis act is against the public policy of this state and is to thatextent unenforceable.
This chapter applies to business paymentcontracts containing a personal guarantee executed on or after January1, 2012.
Sections 1 through 4 of this act constitutea new chapter in Title 19 RCW.
